column1: Breathing normally, Keith presses the mike button and answers... "Go ahead, Captain. This is 53mary2."
column2: 恢復正常呼吸後，基斯按下麥克風按鈕回答……「請說，警監。這裡是 53mary2。」

column1: 10-4. says the Captain..."Have you overtaken the suspect vehicle, or do you have him in sight?"
column2: 「10-4。」警監說……「你們追上嫌犯車輛了嗎？還是看得到他？」

column1: Negative. Keith answers.
column2: 「否定。」基斯回答。

column1: 10-4... 10-22 the pursuit. Return to Cotton Cove and complete the investigation there. Every other unit will continue the search...10-4?
column2: 「10-4……10-22 終止追捕。返回棉花灣，在那裡完成調查。其他單位繼續搜索……10-4？」

column1: Keith speaks up..."10-4, Captain..."
Well, Keith says..."you heard the man."
column2: 「好吧，」基斯說……「你聽到警監的命令了。」

column1: Keith nods. "I'll notify Dispatch."
column2: 基斯點點頭。「我會通知派遣中心。」

column1: Dispatch, Keith says, more calmly now, "53mary2... we are 10-22 on pursuit of Bains' vehicle. 10-97 to %s."
column2: 「派遣中心，」基斯現在冷靜多了，說道，「53mary2……我們已對班恩斯車輛的追捕執行 10-22。10-97 前往 %s。」

column1: As you drive toward %s, Dispatch brings the radio alive with information from a unit in pursuit.
column2: 你開車前往 %s 時，派遣中心透過無線電傳來追捕單位的最新資訊。

column1: Attention all units...be advised 53-10 is in pursuit of fugitive suspect Bains...
column2: 「所有單位注意……請注意 53-10 正在追捕逃犯班恩斯……」

column1: ...The current 10-20 is northbound on Second Street in the vicinity of the airport.
column2: 「……目前 10-20 位於機場附近的第二街，正向北行駛。」

column1: 53-10 is requesting assistance and advises that he's losing suspect in heavy traffic...any unit responding acknowledge...
column2: 「53-10 請求支援，並表示嫌犯在車流中逐漸脫離掌握……任何回應單位請回覆……」

column1: Just then, Keith jumps into the middle of things... "Dispatch, 53Mary2...be advised we are responding to 53-10's 10-20, code 2."
column2: 就在這時，基斯加入通話……「派遣中心，53Mary2……請注意，我們正以二級警示前往 53-10 的 10-20。」

column1: Dispatch confirms your traffic as you respond toward the pursuit. "Copy, 53Mary2."
column2: 你前往追捕現場時，派遣中心確認你的通報。「收到，53Mary2。」

column1: As you continue to respond, 53-10 comes on the air again... "Dispatch, 53-10...I...I lost suspect in heavy traffic."
column2: 你繼續前往現場時，53-10 再次透過無線電通話……「派遣中心，53-10……我……我在車流中跟丟嫌犯了。」

column1: 53-10, 10-4. Dispatch answers..."Confirm last known 10-20 of suspect vehicle..."
column2: 「53-10，10-4。」派遣中心回答……「確認嫌犯車輛最後已知的 10-20……」

column1: You listen attentively as the 53-10 unit answers... "Suspect vehicle last seen in vicinity of airport."
column2: 你專心聆聽 53-10 單位回答……「嫌犯車輛最後出現在機場附近。」

column1: I can't believe it! Keith shouts, "How could he lose him?"
column2: 「真不敢相信！」基斯喊道，「他怎麼會跟丟？」

column1: Dispatch, 53Mary2... request a check be made on license number C035609.
column2: 「派遣中心，53Mary2……請查詢車牌號碼 C035609。」

column1: 53Mary2...be advised your plate number matches that of the vehicle stolen from the mall.
column2: 「53Mary2……請注意，你們的車牌號碼與購物中心遭竊車輛相符。」

column1: Continuing..."VIN number, S1234T10 should match..."
column2: 接著說……「車輛識別號碼應為 S1234T10……」

column1: Attention all units. she says, "10-22 looking for suspect vehicle...53Mary2 has it located."
column2: 她說：「所有單位注意。10-22 搜尋嫌犯車輛……53Mary2 已找到該車。」

column1:
Dispatch, 53Mary2... request a check be made on hand gun, serial number SW5557763.	「派遣中心，53Mary2……請查詢序號為 SW5557763 的手槍。
53Mary2...be advised your number comes back to a 4-inch K-38 Smith and Wesson, registered to Luis Pate.."
column2: 「53Mary2……請注意，查詢結果為一把四吋 K-38 Smith and Wesson，登記人為路易斯．佩特。」

column1: Keith says to you... "Well, Sonny, I guess we should get back and book this evidence."
column2: 基斯對你說……「桑尼，我想我們該回去登記這件證物了。」
